# Component reference

123 components in 9 groups. Every component accepts `.id()`, `.on(event, action)`, `.ai(capability)` and arbitrary props through `.prop(key, value)`. Factory names follow each language's conventions (`ui.text_area` in Python, `ui.textArea` in JavaScript, `UI.TextArea` in C#).

## Layout

[Page](#page) · [Shell](#shell) · [Stack](#stack) · [Row](#row) · [Grid](#grid) · [Split](#split) · [Card](#card) · [Section](#section) · [Tabs](#tabs) · [Tab](#tab) · [Disclosure](#disclosure) · [Divider](#divider) · [Spacer](#spacer) · [Toolbar](#toolbar) · [Modal](#modal) · [Drawer](#drawer) · [Hero](#hero) · [Breadcrumbs](#breadcrumbs) · [Theme](#theme)

### Page

Top-level surface with a title block and a content column. Container.

```python
ui.page("Quarterly review", ui.text("…")).prop("subtitle", "Revenue, retention and risk")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `subtitle` | string | — | Supporting line under the title. |
| `eyebrow` | string | — | Small label above the title. |
| `width` | one of `narrow`, `default`, `wide`, `full` | `"default"` | Maximum content width. |

### Shell

Application frame with brand, navigation rail and a content region. Container.

```python
ui.shell("Northwind", ui.text("…")).prop("nav", [{"label": "Overview", "icon": "home", "route": "/", "active": True}, {"label": "Orders", "icon": "inbox", "route": "/orders", "badge": "12"}])
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `nav` | JSON value | — | Navigation items: [{label, icon, route, badge, section, active}]. |
| `tagline` | string | — | Line under the brand. |
| `user` | JSON value | — | {name, role} shown at the foot of the rail. |
| `footer` | string | — | Small print at the foot of the rail. |

Events: `navigate`

### Stack

Vertical flow with consistent spacing. Container.

```python
ui.stack(ui.text("…")).prop("gap", "sm")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | one of `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` | `"md"` | Space between children. |
| `align` | one of `stretch`, `start`, `center`, `end` | `"stretch"` | Cross-axis alignment. |
| `justify` | one of `start`, `center`, `end`, `between` | `"start"` | Main-axis distribution. |

### Row

Horizontal flow that wraps on small viewports. Container.

```python
ui.row(ui.text("…")).prop("justify", "between")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | one of `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` | `"md"` | Space between children. |
| `align` | one of `start`, `center`, `end`, `stretch`, `baseline` | `"center"` | Cross-axis alignment. |
| `justify` | one of `start`, `center`, `end`, `between` | `"start"` | Main-axis distribution. |
| `wrap` | boolean | `"true"` | Allow wrapping. |

### Grid

Responsive grid; fixed columns or auto-fit by minimum width. Container.

```python
ui.grid(ui.text("…")).prop("columns", 2)
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | number | `"3"` | Column count at full width. |
| `gap` | one of `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` | `"md"` | Space between cells. |
| `minWidth` | number | — | Minimum cell width in px; enables auto-fit. |

### Split

Two-pane layout with a ratio such as 2:1. Container.

```python
ui.split(ui.text("…")).prop("ratio", "2:1")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ratio` | string | `"1:1"` | Width ratio between panes. |
| `gap` | one of `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` | `"lg"` | Space between panes. |

### Card

Grouped surface with optional header. Container.


| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | number | `"0"` | Index of the selected tab. |

### Theme

Applies a theme preset or custom tokens to everything inside it. Container.

```python
ui.theme(ui.text("…")).prop("preset", "midnight")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | one of `deep`, `abyss`, `iris`, `midnight`, `aurora`, `sunset`, `ember`, `ocean`, `forest`, `moss`, `rose`, `grape`, `citrus`, `sand`, `graphite`, `paper`, `terminal`, `crimson`, `candy`, `mint`, `gold`, `sky`, `emerald`, `neon`, `ruby`, `lagoon`, `tangerine` | — | Named palette and type pairing. |
| `scheme` | one of `auto`, `light`, `dark` | `"auto"` | Force a colour scheme. |
| `fill` | boolean | `"true"` | Paint the themed background. |
| `tokens` | JSON value | — | Extra tokens: [{name, value}]. |

```python
ui.heading("Team activity").prop("level", 3)
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `level` | number | `"2"` | Heading level 1–4. |

### Text

Body text.

```python
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").prop("tone", "muted")
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `tone` | one of `default`, `muted`, `strong`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `brand` | `"default"` | Colour role. |
| `size` | one of `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` | `"md"` | Type size. |
| `weight` | one of `regular`, `medium`, `bold` | `"regular"` | Font weight. |
| `align` | one of `start`, `center`, `end` | `"start"` | Alignment. |

### Stat

Key figure with delta and sparkline.

```python
ui.stat("Net revenue", "$84,210").prop("delta", "+12.4%").prop("trend", "up").prop("spark", [3, 4, 4, "… 4 more"])
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `value` (argument) | string | — | Positional argument. |
| `delta` | string | — | Change text such as +12.4%. |
| `trend` | one of `up`, `down`, `flat` | — | Direction of change. |
| `hint` | string | — | Small supporting text. |
| `spark` | JSON value | — | Number series drawn as a sparkline. |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `brand`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` | `"neutral"` | Colour role. |
| `icon` | string | — | Icon name. |

| `showValue` | boolean | `"true"` | Print the percentage. |

### Chat

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
